text: 3M is an NYSE-listed conglomerate with no controlling or state shareholder. The Cadillac F1 partnership is private corporate money. 3M's notable human-rights/conduct exposure is litigation-driven - PFAS ('forever chemicals') contamination settlements and combat-earplug hearing-loss claims - not state ownership.
short: 3M is an NYSE-listed conglomerate with no controlling or state shareholder.
